description_md:
The Hackathon Robotique Défense brings together engineering students to work on defense robotics topics over three days, co-organized with the Agence de l'Innovation de Défense (Ministère des Armées). Teams of 4 to 8 people will tackle challenges across two tracks: autonomous navigation and mobility in hostile terrain, and fine manipulation and logistics.

Participants take part in mentoring sessions and preliminary work to learn to use a simulator before the final sprint, testing, and prize ceremony on the Adopt AI stage.
